snippet.title: Clash of Coins - Example Gameplay
snippet.description:
Clash of Coins is a local 2 player brawler made in 5 days for the UE4Jam Spring 2019. The theme was "The Other Side of the Coin".

Download and play the game for free here:
https://zwizausch.itch.io/clash-of-coins

Created by B.Ayo, R.Brockhaus, L.Langenberg, D.Witzgall and Z.Zausch.
